title: Soft Dan Noodles with Chinese Sushi
description: A simple and delicious fusion of dan noodles with the flavors of Chinese sushi. This dish can be prepared in under an hour and serves 4.
instructions: Cook the dan noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, combine the sushi rice vinegar, soy sauce, grated ginger, and sesame oil. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the cooked dan noodles to the saucepan and stir to coat with the sauce.
Serve the noodles with a side of soft rice.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions, if desired.
